title: NovaBank – Credit Risk Analytics
description: Credit risk analysis on a 32,574-loan portfolio. Identified a segment holding 10.4% of loans but 29.4% of defaults, and a DTI breakpoint at 0.40 — turned into underwriting recommendations. Delivered a 4-page Power BI dashboard (live link).

title: Bank Transactions Analytics
description: End-to-end ELT pipeline over 20,000 transactions (8,025 customers, 29 months) with 100% row reconciliation. Star schema (6 dims, 1 fact) with data-quality tests; Power BI report answering 12 business questions.

title: Financial Distress Early-Warning Model
description: Early-warning classifier for financial distress across Nasdaq-100 firms (45 indicators, 2017–2022). Time-based split to prevent look-ahead bias; improved F1 from 69.2% to 75.9% via causal feature weighting, beating the classical baseline (74.1%).

title: Financial Data Analysis with Vietstock
description: Financial performance analysis of ~30 Vietnamese listed companies from Vietstock statements. Computed ratios and sector comparisons in Excel (PivotTables), including sector-wise tariff/election impact.
